zh.title: 人类太慢了，所以这部短片是 AI 做的｜TOO SLOW
zh.title_short: 人类太慢了，这片是 AI 做的
zh.description:
AI 公司的国王们围坐一桌出牌，倒计时越来越短。屏幕上弹出一句话："太慢了？让 AI 替你出。"

这部 2 分 42 秒的短片，编剧是人类，其余全部由 Claude Fable 5.2 用代码完成：没有视频模型，没有任何素材，画面和配乐都是一行行代码算出来的。

另一个世界的故事，如有雷同，纯属巧合。请看到最后一秒。
zh.description_short:
人类太慢了，所以这部短片是 AI 做的。
编剧是人，画面、配乐、剪辑全是 AI 用代码写出来的，没有用任何视频模型。
请看到最后一秒。
zh.one_line: 我只写了剧本。剩下的 2.3 万行代码，是 AI 写的。
zh.pinned_comment:
制作说明：编剧是我（人类）。导演、动画、配乐、音效、剪辑由 Claude Fable 5.2 用代码完成，约 2.3 万行 JavaScript，82 个镜头，前后改了 22 版。没有使用任何图像、视频或音频生成模型，也没有任何素材文件，画面由 three.js 算出，配乐和音效由代码合成。
片中出现的公司名称和标志仅用于讽刺，故事发生在另一个世界，如有雷同，纯属巧合。

en.title: Humans Were Too Slow. So an AI Made This Film. | TOO SLOW (4K)
en.title_short: Humans were too slow, so an AI made this film.
en.description:
The kings of the AI labs sit at one table and play their cards. The clock keeps getting shorter. Then every screen makes a polite offer: "Too slow? Let AI play for you."

A 2:42 dark comedy. Written by a human. Everything else, every frame and every note, was made in code by Claude Fable 5.2: no video model, no image model, no assets.

Set in another world. Any resemblance to the real one is purely coincidental. Stay for the credits.
en.description_short:
Humans were too slow, so an AI made this film.
Written by a human. Every frame and every note was coded by an AI. No video model.
Stay for the credits.
en.pinned_comment:
How it was made: I (a human) wrote the script. Directing, animation, score, sound and editing were done in code by Claude Fable 5.2: about 23,000 lines of JavaScript, 82 shots, 22 versions. No image, video or audio model was used and there are no asset files; the picture is rendered with three.js and the score is synthesized in code.
Company names and logos appear as satire. The story is set in another world; any resemblance to the real one is purely coincidental.
